$comment: The scripts Studio Designer generates into a package, and the stock Web UI script it copies in, known by the SHA-256 of their shape (src/script-shape.ts): tokens without comments or spacing, literals as placeholders, trailing commas dropped, and a run of search sort options counted as one. Any other script in a layout, search screen, slot bundle, dashboard or theme is customer code, and the inventory lists it as a decision. A new Studio or Web UI version that changes a template adds an entry here.

source.how: Every script in the sample package, a Studio project for Nuxeo LTS 2025 with Web UI 2025.

scripts.name: Studio's search results
scripts.note: Its sort options are configuration, read with the search screen, so their number does not change the shape.

scripts.name: Web UI's stock home
scripts.seen: the sample's nuxeo-home.html, which Studio copies from Web UI 2025 when a project customises the dashboard
scripts.note: A dashboard whose script differs has customer code in it.
